# K-210 Plant Air Compressor: Start, Stop, and Protection

This is a draft for review. The numeric values are in the setpoint list (Section 2) and are not repeated in the text. Items marked TBD need vendor or project data. They are not invented here, and each is tracked in Section 9.

## 1. Scope and interfaces

| Item | Definition |
|---|---|
| Equipment | K-210 compressor, 6.6 kV motor with soft starter, P-212 auxiliary oil pump, FV-211 blow-off valve, ZC-210/ZT-210 inlet guide vanes (IGV) |
| Control owner | DCS owns start, stop, permissives, sequences, and the start-limit counters |
| Vendor controller | Owns the surge line and its surge protection. The vendor controller opens FV-211 on surge. |
| Other documents | Cause-and-effect chart (K-210 C&E), alarm database (ISA-18.2), instrument index, SRS (if any trip is in the SIS) |

**FR-K210-001.** Any open demand for FV-211 shall win over any close demand. This includes the surge-protection demand from the vendor controller. *Test: force surge-line demand while the DCS commands close. FV-211 stays open.*

## 2. Setpoint list (single source of truth)

|---|---|---|---|---|
| SP-01 | Oil header pressure, normal | PT-213 | 2.5 bar | Reference only |
| SP-02 | Oil header pressure, low alarm | PT-213 | 1.8 bar | |
| SP-03 | Oil header pressure, low-low trip | PT-213 | 1.3 bar | |
| SP-04 | Oil pressure start permissive (P-212 running) | PT-213 | TBD | Vendor. Must be above SP-02. |
| SP-05 | P-212 auto-start pressure (standby duty) | PT-213 | TBD | Vendor. Must be above SP-02. |
| SP-06 | Oil temperature start permissive (minimum) | TT-214 | 25 °C | |
| SP-07 | Vibration alarm (each stage) | VT-215/216/217 | 40 µm | |
| SP-08 | Vibration trip (each stage) | VT-215/216/217 | 60 µm | |
| SP-09 | Discharge header pressure control setpoint | PIC (tag TBD) | 7.0 barg | Used in the loaded state |
| SP-10 | Maximum starts per hour | n/a | 3 | Motor vendor limit |
| SP-11 | Minimum time between hot starts | n/a | 20 min | Motor vendor limit |
| SP-12 | P-212 pressure proof time | n/a | TBD | |
| SP-13 | IGV start position | ZT-210 | TBD | |
| SP-14 | Valve and IGV position-confirm timeout | ZT-210, FV-211 | TBD | |
| SP-15 | Motor acceleration timeout | n/a | TBD | Vendor |
| SP-16 | Main oil pump takeover proof time | PT-213 | TBD | |
| SP-17 | Unloaded warm-up time | n/a | TBD | Vendor |

## 3. States and transitions (ISA-106)

| State | Entry permissive | Initiator | Allowed exits | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| STOPPED-NOT READY | Default state. Any start permissive is false. | Auto | READY | Automatic |
| READY | All start permissives (FR-K210-010) are true. | Auto | STARTING, STOPPED-NOT READY | Automatic |
| STARTING | READY and operator START command | Operator | RUN-UNLOADED, STOPPED-NOT READY (failure before motor start), STOPPING (operator STOP), TRIPPED | Operator-initiated, then automatic |
| RUN-UNLOADED | Motor at full speed, main oil pump takeover proven | Auto | RUN-LOADED, STOPPING, TRIPPED | Automatic |
| RUN-LOADED | Warm-up complete and no vibration alarm active | Auto | RUN-UNLOADED, STOPPING, TRIPPED | Automatic |
| STOPPING | Operator STOP command | Operator | STOPPED-NOT READY, TRIPPED | Operator-initiated, then automatic |
| TRIPPED | Any trip cause in the C&E | Auto | STOPPED-NOT READY (operator reset, FR-K210-031) | Automatic trip, manual reset |

## 4. Start permissives and start limits

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-K210-010 | The DCS shall set READY only when all of the following are true: no latched trip; remote control selected; TT-214 above SP-06; P-212 available and in auto; soft starter and 6.6 kV breaker ready with no fault; vendor controller healthy with no trip; VT-215/216/217, PT-213, TT-214, ZT-210 good quality; each of VT-215/216/217 below SP-07; start-limit lockouts clear (FR-K210-011, -012). | FAT: remove each condition one at a time. READY drops each time. |
| FR-K210-011 | The DCS shall count each motor start command. It shall block START when the count in the last hour has reached SP-10. | FAT: issue starts until the limit. The next START is blocked. |
| FR-K210-012 | The DCS shall block START until SP-11 has elapsed since the previous start. The DCS shall treat every start as a hot start until the hot-start definition is closed (OI-04). | FAT: restart before the timer ends. START is blocked. |
| FR-K210-013 | The DCS shall keep the start counter and timers through a DCS restart and a power loss. | FAT: restart the DCS controller during lockout. Timers continue. |
| FR-K210-014 | The DCS shall show the reason for each missing permissive on the K-210 faceplate. | FAT: inspect the faceplate with each permissive false. |
| FR-K210-015 | When TT-214 is below SP-06 in the stopped state, the DCS shall enable the tank heater. | FAT: simulate low TT-214. The heater command goes on. |

## 5. Start sequence (SqBC)

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Operator pushes START. DCS confirms READY. | READY is true. | None | START is rejected with a message. |
| S2 | Start P-212. | PT-213 above SP-04 for SP-12. | SP-12 plus margin (TBD) | Stop P-212. Go to STOPPED-NOT READY. Raise alarm. |
| S3 | Command ZC-210 to the IGV start position. Command FV-211 open. | ZT-210 at SP-13. FV-211 confirmed open. | SP-14 | Go to STOPPED-NOT READY. Raise alarm. Keep P-212 running for SP-21. |
| S4 | Start the soft starter. | Motor at full speed. Bypass confirmation is received. | SP-15 | Stop the soft starter. Go to TRIPPED. Count the start. |
| S5 | Keep P-212 running. Wait for the main oil pump to take over. | PT-213 stays above SP-05 for SP-16. | SP-16 | Keep P-212 running. Raise alarm. Continue. Do not stop P-212 until the operator clears the alarm. |
| S6 | Run unloaded. Keep IGV at start position and FV-211 open. | SP-17 elapsed and all vibration below SP-07. | SP-17 plus margin (TBD) | Hold in RUN-UNLOADED. Raise alarm. The operator decides to stop or wait. |
| S7 | Release load control. | FV-211 closed. Discharge pressure controller in AUTO. | SP-18 | Return to RUN-UNLOADED. Raise alarm. |

After S5, the DCS shall set P-212 to standby with auto-start at SP-05 (FR-K210-020).

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-K210-020 | P-212 shall auto-start when PT-213 falls below SP-05 in any running state. | FAT: lower the PT-213 simulation. P-212 starts. |
| FR-K210-021 | The DCS shall not start the soft starter before S2 and S3 are complete. | FAT: force S2 and S3 incomplete. Soft starter does not start. |
| FR-K210-022 | In RUN-LOADED, the discharge controller shall hold the discharge header at SP-09. Loading is detailed in the capacity control section. | FAT: see capacity control section. |

## 6. Normal stop sequence

| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| N1 | Operator pushes STOP. Command IGV to start position. Command FV-211 open. | ZT-210 at SP-13. FV-211 confirmed open. | SP-19 | Raise alarm. Command FV-211 open again. Continue to N2. |
| N2 | Stop the soft starter. | Motor run feedback is false. | SP-20 | Trip the 6.6 kV breaker. Raise alarm. |
| N3 | Keep P-212 running. | SP-21 elapsed. | SP-21 | If P-212 fails, raise alarm. Go to N4. |
| N4 | Stop P-212. | P-212 stopped. | SP-14 | Raise alarm. |

The DCS shall go to STOPPED-NOT READY after N4. The DCS shall start the lockout timers (FR-K210-011, -012) from the motor stop.

## 7. Protection

Protective actions are defined in the K-210 C&E. This table gives the requirement IDs and test methods only.

| ID | Cause | Setpoint | Action (per C&E) | Test method |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-K210-030 | PT-213 low alarm | SP-02 | Raise alarm. Start P-212 if not running. | FAT: lower PT-213 simulation. |
| FR-K210-031 | Trip reset | n/a | The operator shall reset a trip only after the cause is clear and the first-out is acknowledged. The DCS shall latch the trip until reset. | FAT: trip, clear cause, reset. |
| FR-K210-032 | PT-213 low-low | SP-03 | Trip motor (coast, no soft stop). Open FV-211. Start P-212. Go to TRIPPED. | FAT: lower PT-213 below SP-03 while running. |
| FR-K210-033 | Vibration alarm, any of VT-215/216/217 | SP-07 | Raise alarm. Block load release. | FAT: raise each VT simulation. |
| FR-K210-034 | Vibration trip, any of VT-215/216/217 | SP-08 | Trip motor (coast). Open FV-211. Start P-212. Go to TRIPPED. | FAT: raise each VT simulation. |
| FR-K210-035 | Surge detected by vendor controller | Vendor surge line | The vendor controller opens FV-211. The DCS shall show a surge indication and count surge events. | FAT: simulate surge-line crossing. |
| FR-K210-036 | Other trips | Per C&E | Per C&E | Per C&E |

FR-K210-037. The trip action shall not use the soft stop ramp. *Test: trip the unit. The motor coasts.*

SIS functions are not specified here. If OI-01 assigns any trip to the SIS, this narrative shall reference the SRS row.

## 8. Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Required behavior | Test method |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-K210-040 | PT-213 bad quality, stopped | Block start. Raise alarm. | FAT: fail PT-213 signal. |
| FR-K210-041 | PT-213 bad quality, running | Start P-212. Raise alarm. Trip after SP-22 if not restored. | FAT: fail PT-213 while running. |
| FR-K210-042 | Any VT-215/216/217 bad quality, stopped | Block start. | FAT: fail each VT. |
| FR-K210-043 | Any VT-215/216/217 bad quality, running | Raise alarm. Trip after SP-22 if not restored. | FAT: fail each VT while running. |
| FR-K210-044 | TT-214 bad quality | Block start. In running states, raise alarm only. | FAT: fail TT-214. |
| FR-K210-045 | ZT-210 bad quality | Block start. In running states, raise alarm. Hold FV-211 open demand in RUN-UNLOADED. | FAT: fail ZT-210. |
| FR-K210-046 | DCS to vendor controller comms loss | Block start. In running states, raise alarm. The DCS shall not trip the unit on comms loss alone. Vendor surge protection and hardwired trips stay active. | FAT: disconnect the link while running. |
| FR-K210-047 | 6.6 kV power loss | Motor stops. DCS goes to TRIPPED. P-212 starts when AC power returns. | SAT: simulated bus loss. |
| FR-K210-048 | Restart after power loss | The DCS shall not restart K-210 automatically. The operator shall reset and start. Lockouts remain in force. | FAT: restore power. K-210 stays stopped. |
| FR-K210-049 | DCS controller failure | Fail positions in the table below apply. Hardwired trips stay active. | FAT: fail the DCS controller. |

**Fail positions (proposed, to confirm with vendor):**

| Device | Fail position |
|---|---|
| FV-211 | Open |
| ZC-210 (IGV) | Closed (minimum flow position) |
| P-212 | Stopped (de-energized) |
| Soft starter | Stopped (loss of run command) |
| Tank heater | Off |

## 9. Operator interface

| ID | Requirement | Test method |
|---|---|---|
| FR-K210-050 | The K-210 faceplate shall show state, active permissives, sequence step, and step timer. | FAT: inspection. |
| FR-K210-051 | The faceplate shall have START, STOP, and TRIP RESET commands. | FAT: operate each. |
| FR-K210-052 | The faceplate shall show starts in the last hour and time to next allowed start. | FAT: inspection. |
| FR-K210-053 | The DCS shall prompt the operator on a hold or failure in S5, S6, or S7. | FAT: force each failure. |
| FR-K210-054 | The DCS shall record first-out for each trip. | FAT: trip from each cause. |

Operations shall sign off the states and prompts before FAT.

## 10. Open items

| ID | Item | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| OI-01 | Decide whether PT-213 low-low and vibration trips are in the SIS, vendor protection, or the DCS. Add the SRS reference or vote logic. | Controls lead with process safety | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-02 | Confirm the trip voting. PT-213 has a single transmitter. Confirm if a second one is needed. | Controls lead | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-03 | Confirm lube adequacy during coast-down. P-212 is AC powered and may be lost with the 6.6 kV supply. | Vendor and process engineer | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-04 | Define "hot start" and the start of the 20 min timer (from previous start or from stop). The draft assumes every start is hot and counts from motor stop. | Motor vendor and controls lead | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-05 | Supply TBD values SP-04, -05, -12 to -22 and tags for the soft starter, tank heater, and discharge pressure controller. | Vendor and instrument engineer | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-06 | Confirm who owns the final command to ZC-210 and FV-211 (DCS or vendor controller), and confirm the fail positions. | Vendor and controls lead | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-07 | Confirm vibration trip bypass during start-up, if any. The draft has none. | Vendor and operations | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-08 | Decide the action on bad-quality vibration and oil pressure signals. Confirm SP-22. | Operations and controls lead | Before FAT procedure issue |
| OI-09 | Operations sign-off on states, prompts, and the warm-up hold behavior. | Operations lead | Before FAT |

No project dates were given, so the due dates are milestones. Replace them with calendar dates at review.

## Pre-presentation check

- **Numbers:** the numbers are only in the setpoint list. The prose has none.
- **IDs and tests:** each requirement has an ID and a test method.
- **Sequences and states:** each sequence step has a timeout and failure response. Each state has entry permissives and exits.
- **Abnormal cases:** the bad PV, comms loss, power loss and restart, and fail positions cases are defined.
- **References:** the interlocks, alarms, and SIS functions are referenced, not duplicated.
- **STE:** the STE pass is not complete. Sentence length is met, but approved-dictionary checks need a pass once the engineering content is settled.
